# SteamLite 10.1.0

Games from outside Steam, an in-game overlay, the streak celebration, voice messages, groups and GIFs, in-app updates and more themes.

- Add a game: games from other stores or ones you installed yourself. Click Add a game in the Library, pick the program's .exe or choose from the programs found in your Start menu (several at once). They launch from SteamLite, SteamLite tracks the time you play, and Remove from library on the game page takes one out again (with Undo).
- The streak celebration is back: when you extend or restore your streak, a flame, the new count and a burst of sparks (confetti on milestones) play over the app. Click it to close it.
- In-game overlay: a small see-through card in the top right corner that stays over your game and lets every click through. It shows the game and how long you have played, the time, your streak and new messages. Show or hide it with Ctrl + Alt + O (changeable in Settings > Shortcuts), or switch on Settings > In-game overlay to have it open with every game. It works over windowed and borderless games, not over games in exclusive full screen.
- The browser's own right-click menu and developer tools are gone from the app. Text boxes keep a right-click menu for copy and paste.
- Voice messages: press the microphone in the message box, speak, and send (about two minutes fit in one message). Voice messages from friends play right in the chat with a bar that follows along.
- Group chats: the new group button in Messages makes a chat with up to 19 of your friends.
- GIFs: pick GIF from the plus button, search, and send one. GIFs that cannot load are left out and each one keeps its size while loading. GIFs come from Giphy (Tenor closed its service).
- In-app updates are back: an update downloads inside SteamLite with a progress bar (how much has arrived and how fast), is checked, and then Restart and update installs it and opens SteamLite again by itself. If the download fails, the stand-alone updater is still used.
- 28 more themes, among them Tokyo Night, Rose Pine, Kanagawa, Poimandres, Night Owl, Matrix Green and Amber Terminal.
- The SteamLite core now keeps a smaller memory limit for itself.
